biography:
Vice President of Energy Strategy at Aligned Data Centers, driving the company’s global energy strategy and partnerships with utilities, energy providers, and hyperscale/AI customers. Focused on acquisition of powered land and aligning large-scale power demand with innovative solutions such as cogeneration, SMRs, hydrogen, and battery storage, while shaping public policy in core markets.

Bring 20+ years of experience in gas, power, renewables, and energy trading—originating over 1 GW of renewable projects, deploying 100 MW+ of distributed assets, and delivering multimillion-dollar results by optimizing portfolios, managing risk, and structuring complex transactions. Experienced in building and leading high-performing, growing teams across commercial, technical, and strategic functions. Deep expertise across North American gas and power markets with international experience in Europe and Asia. Committed to advancing the energy transition through strategic partnerships and scalable, commercially viable solutions.
